name: anwar-shah-and-sons
description: E-commerce platform for Anwar Shah & Sons: Next.js storefront and NestJS API

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && (npm run dev -w shared & npm run dev -w api & npm run dev -w web & wait)
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run build:shared && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
